arabic.text: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ (١٣) وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ (١٤) يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ (١٥) وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ (١٦) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ (١٧) ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ (١٨) يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ (١٩)

keywords.def: a nasal sound held for two counts
a bounce on ق ط ب ج د when sakin

questions.q: Whole class recites Al-Infitar together once.
Hifdh test turns: today's group recites Al-Infitar and reads two check words. Everyone else: rota revision and the log.
Extend: recite Al-Mutaffifin 1 to 6 from the rota.
«طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ» at the stop has qalqalah on ...
questions.a: A) ق. Stopping makes the last ق sakin: qalqalah.

questions.q: Think again: This is the last new surah of the year in Year 6. What will you do to keep all your surahs strong over the summer?
questions.a: A daily rota of 10 to 15 minutes, saying surahs in salah, and reciting to a parent.
